parole.significato: A Sri Lankan pancake made from a fermented batter of rice flour, coconut milk, and palm toddy or yeast.
parole.testo: From Sinhalese ආප්ප (āppa), from Tamil ஆப்பம் (āppam). Doublet of appam.

parole.significato: A Sri Lankan coconut custard pudding made with jaggery, cashew nuts, eggs, spices, etc.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sinhalese වටලප්පන් (waṭalappan), from Tamil வட்டிலப்பம் (vaṭṭilappam).
